about: Superseded by data/real_sp.json + ida/ffxi_ida_fix.py, which measure the real depth and correct IDA wherever it differs (including these two points). Kept as the hand-found record: the real SP change of an instruction where IDA's analysis is wrong, found by pipeline/ida_sp_check.py.

0x100C6693.why: call [eax+318h] (CXiSkeletonActor slot 0x318 = 0x100A4A10, ret): pops nothing; IDA took the preceding push ebp/push edi as arguments

0x100C7902.why: call [eax+3C8h] (slot 0x3C8 = 0x100CFAD0, ret 4): pops its one argument; IDA counted 0
